background_note: People and days are context, not constraints. Do not infer a value when daily_need is missing.

constraint_names.coverage: Assign exactly daily_need distinct employees each day
constraint_names.per_person_max: No employee works more than per_person_max days this week
constraint_names.availability: Employees listed as unavailable must not be scheduled

minimal_definition: A minimal conflict set is infeasible, and removing any one constraint makes it feasible.
